We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. practical application in a business context.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Project & Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ambiguity Navigation: The ability to manage innovation projects from start to finish, creating structure, clear plans, and milestones where none existed before.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: A talent for building coalitions and working with diverse teams (e.g., Technology, Finance, People) to get pilot projects off the ground and secure their expert contribution.</li> <li>Influential Communication: The ability to articulate the goals, progress, and outcomes of innovation projects to a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, building excitement and buy-in along the way.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Requirements</strong></p> <ul> tangible projects, pilot programs, or new business capabilities.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with experience managing complex, ambiguous projects in an innovation or R&D context.</li> <li>Excellent business analysis and financial modeling skills, with experience building business cases and measuring the impact of new initiatives.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging technologies like AI/automation and a deep understanding of how they can be applied to drive business value.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Measures of Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Within 6 Months: You will have taken ownership of one or two key innovation initiatives from the Advancement roadmap. You will have designed and launched a structured pilot program for your primary initiative, complete with clear goals, metrics, a project plan, and strong engagement from supporting teams.</li> <li>Within 12 Months: You will have completed your first major pilot program, delivering a comprehensive analysis of the results to senior leadership. You will be recognized as a key leader in driving the innovation agenda, successfully translating vision into proven concepts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WPP Media Values:</strong> </p> <p>WPP media is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on being a company that embraces difference and truly represents the global clients we work with.</p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time. As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: People Leadership & Talent Development Team Management Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management. Formal Training & Growth Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports. Recruitment & Retention Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture. Culture of Learning Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference. Strategic & Operational Management Budget & Capacity Planning Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware. Risk & Contingency Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity. Procedure & Frameworks Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards. Prioritisation Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations. Technical Support & Oversight Performance Optimisation Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them. Visual Documentation Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor. Hybrid Estate Management Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments. Unblocking Issues Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover. General Duties On-Call Duties Willingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-Hoc Carry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Leadership & Management Competencies Proven Management Experience Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc). Project Management Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment. Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. Goal Oriented You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met. ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts. Technical Environment & Team Capabilities Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration. Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey. Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation. Innovation & Debt Management A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt. Advanced Containerization Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems. Web & Storage Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster. Tooling Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Version Control strong understanding of Git and version control best practices. Why This Role? If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. title: Data Scientist - Broker Flow
description: Data Scientist - Broker Flow Team Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Broker Flow team. You'll own the experiments that shape the journey brokers use to apply on their clients' behalf. Brokers are one of iwoca's main routes to new customers. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team Broker Flow, a new team in iwoca's third-party acquisition department, owns the journey for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – from before they apply to a completed credit assessment. Its aim is to get more of those businesses to an offer. Broker Terms, a separate team, then sets the price, amount, and duration of each offer. The team works on three parts of that journey: Broker engagement. Working with brokers and their clients before an application starts. The application. Making it smooth to complete, and collecting the data a credit decision needs. Operations. Running the CRM tools iwoca's teams work in, and automating operational processes. The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use. The role As the Data Scientist in Broker Flow, you'll give the team the evidence behind its product decisions. The core of the work is experiment design and causal inference, with modelling and analysis alongside it. You'll own each project end to end. You'll frame the problem, choose the method, build the model or run the test, and take the answer to the commercial and strategy colleagues who act on it. You'll also meet brokers in person, which gives you the context to ask the right questions. The team is new, so its methods are yours to shape. You'll see the effect of your work in how many businesses reach an offer, and in their lifetime value. You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other broker and partner teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to compare methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings, short write-ups that iwoca shares at weekly and fortnightly sessions. Live project examples: Refinancing. Modelling which businesses would benefit from refinancing their existing borrowing, and testing a product for them. Stalled applications. Finding where broker applications stall, and testing fixes – from clearer emails and portal updates to an early offer that encourages document upload. Reintroductions. Testing the best moment for brokers to bring existing iwoca customers back to borrow. Approval probability. Measuring how well the estimate brokers see in the Introducer Portal predicts actual credit decisions, and making it more accurate. Measuring impact. Designing early signals – at sign-up and once documents are in – that predict a business's lifetime value, so the team can judge its changes quickly. The requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work. Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it. Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them. Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling. Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python. The salary We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Graduate Data & Insight Analyst at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>As Graduate Data & Insight Analyst, you will support the delivery of consumer and market insight across THG’s Beauty and Nutrition divisions. This is an entry-level role for a curious, analytically minded graduate who wants to build a career in insight and market research. You will work closely with the Insight Manager and Insight Lead to learn research methodology, develop your analytical skills and contribute to insight that informs senior decisions across the group.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Research Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support delivery of primary and secondary research projects — data collection, coding, analysis and report preparation</li> <li>Maintain and update brand tracking, NPS and consumer panel datasets</li> <li>Research competitors, market trends and consumer behaviour — collating and summarising findings</li> <li>Prepare slides, reports and briefing documents to support Insight Manager and Insight Lead outputs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data & Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyse survey data and quantitative research outputs — producing clear summaries and basic visualisations</li> <li>Support the maintenance of insight databases and knowledge libraries</li> <li>Carry out desk research — sourcing market reports, industry data and competitor intelligence</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Contribution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute reliably to team projects — meeting deadlines and flagging issues early</li> <li>Learn from the Insight Manager and Insight Lead — asking good questions and applying feedback</li> <li>Build working knowledge of research methodology, the beauty and nutrition sectors, and THG’s consumer base</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Graduate or equivalent with a degree in a relevant discipline — market research, social science, business, psychology, data science or similar</li> <li>Genuine curiosity about consumer behaviour and market dynamics</li> <li>Strong analytical thinking — able to work with data and draw clear conclusions</li> <li>Excellent written communication — able to summarise findings clearly and concisely</li> <li>Organised and reliable — able to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior exposure to market research, consumer insight or analytics — internship, placement or project work</li> <li>Familiarity with survey tools or data analysis software</li> <li>Interest in beauty, wellness, nutrition or e-commerce sectors</li> <li>Basic Excel or data skills</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access to our subsidised on-site dentist</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.</li> <li>Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF</strong></p> <p><strong>About Central Functions</strong></p> <p>Central Functions is formed of the teams and people that serve the entire business. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be the Data Engineering Lead at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>THG is building the data engineering capability that will underpin everything from daily trading analytics to AI-driven personalisation. As Engineering Lead, you will own the technical vision and delivery for how THG structures, stores and distributes its data across three core domains: Customer, Commercial and Operations.</p> <p>This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be managing and mentoring a team of six engineers (three Senior, three mid-level, each domain-aligned), but you are also expected to be technically deep — setting architecture standards, making key design decisions, and being the person the team turns to when problems are hard.</p> <p>Your primary mission is to move THG from a fragmented, siloed data landscape towards consistent, joined-up domain datasets that can be trusted and used at scale. We have customer data in multiple places, commercial data that isn't consistently structured, and operational data that isn't easy to consume. You will build the engineering foundation that changes that — working to a shared architecture that ensures Customer, Commercial and Operations datasets have consistent standards, shared attributes where appropriate, and can ultimately be joined into a single, reliable view of the business.</p> <p>You will work closely with Ingenuity, our technology partner, who manage the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines. Your job is to take what Ingenuity provides and shape it into the structured, high-quality domain datasets that analytics and data science teams can confidently build on. You will also be a key partner to the Data Governance Lead, implementing the standards they define within your engineering practice.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!</p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Data Scientist
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our team. You'll work on projects across the business, from building credit scoring models and improving fraud detection to optimizing field visit schedules and designing A/B tests for targeted user promotions. In this role, you'll partner with product managers and business leaders to understand the problems they're trying to solve and find practical ways to use data to improve outcomes. Our ideal candidate is product-minded, scrappy and thinks about data in terms of intuitive user behaviours rather than just inputs to a black box model. In this role you'll; Be embedded closely with our product and operations teams. Generate insights using customer, merchant and internal data using statistical modelling, data visualization, and machine learning. Design, implement and analyze optimizations for our internal operations, user promos, and agent network to help teams scale and reduce costs. Build data-driven heuristics and machine-learning models to improve user and business outcomes. Take ownership of the analytics process - from project scoping and design to communicating findings to stakeholders. Key details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (US, UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates. Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $130,600 - $236,200 USD, plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year. $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Requirements Education and Experience Minimum Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master's or PhD is a plus. 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or technical analytics roles. Technical Skills Deep expertise with Python, SQL, and data visualization tools Experience in one or more of the following: machine learning, causal inference, statistical modeling, or A/B testing. Experience applying these methods in operational settings with offline components (example: incentive structures for field staff) is a plus. Highly effective written communication and presentation skills A track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and business stakeholder Fluency in English. French is a plus. You might be a good fit if you Have a bias for action and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive forward progress. Have worked in early stage product teams (or a rapidly scaling product) and are able to drive product decisions. Have excellent focus, prioritizing your research and work using an iterative approach (you know when a project is good enough to stop, and you rarely get lost in details). Are able to compellingly present your findings to technical and non-technical audiences and make proactive recommendations based on data. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. Based in London or Paris and on-site five days a week, you will work closely with Operations, Quality Assurance, Knowledge, Enterprise and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive scalable, high-quality tooling solutions that enable our global customer base to receive best-in-class support. What you’ll be doing Lead, mentor and line-manage a team of Salesforce Administrators, setting clear objectives, providing technical guidance and supporting their professional development. Own and scale Service Cloud (including Omni-Channel), Experience Cloud portals and integrations with external enterprise systems, evaluating third-party tooling where it extends Salesforce. Own release management, CI/CD and the development backlog in JIRA, keeping releases stable and secure and prioritisation transparent, and lead technical projects from discovery through deployment. Drive platform governance: define best practices, enforce data protection and retention policies, and maintain technical documentation. Lead AI initiatives, beyond Agentforce, that improve efficiency and customer experience across Customer Success. What we’re looking for Able to work on-site five days a week in our London or Paris office. A minimum of five years’ hands-on Salesforce experience in high-volume B2B and/or B2C environments, including Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, API integrations and CI/CD. Proven experience operating and troubleshooting Agentforce (core requirement; general AI chatbot experience is not a substitute). Deep expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce architecture. Demonstrated experience leading a Salesforce team, with the confidence to coach, delegate and hold others accountable. Salesforce certified as Administrator, Platform App Builder and Platform Developer; Service Cloud Consultant and Agentforce Specialist are a strong advantage. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences. title: AI Safety Manager
description: Slingshot AI Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want. We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London. We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others. The role We’re hiring a leader to help shape how we approach trust and safety at Ash, in our model and in our product. People bring deeply personal things to Ash. That creates difficult questions about how the product should behave, how we respond when something goes wrong, and how we protect people while respecting their privacy and autonomy. You’ll work alongside psychologists, researchers, and machine learning engineers to develop novel systems for AI in a sensitive domain. You’ll help us answer hard, ambiguous questions about our model’s policy, investigate, research, develop new policies, and implement them, and communicate clearly about them to both internal and external audiences. The role combines strategy, hands-on operations, and communication. You might spend one day working through a difficult safety decision with our clinical and legal teams, the next building a process for handling user reports, and the next writing an explanation of our approach for the public. We’re looking for a thoughtful generalist who learns quickly, makes things happen, and cares deeply about getting this right. What you’ll do Develop our principles and policies. Work through questions where safety, privacy, user autonomy, and product usefulness pull in different directions. Research the problem, seek expert input, and make a reasoned recommendation. You’ll work with our team, our advisors and experts and others to build principles for how to handle decisions. Turn ambiguous issues into clear decisions. Investigate user reports, emerging risks, and new requirements. Establish what we know, what remains uncertain, and what we should do next. Make the response work in practice. Build clear processes for triage, investigation, escalation, and follow-through. Define who does what, create the tools and documentation they need, and handle the operational details yourself. Turn learning into product improvements. Work with engineering, machine learning, clinical, and legal colleagues to translate findings into changes to Ash and the systems around it. Build, test, and improve quickly. For new systems, put a useful first version in place, learn from real cases, and refine it. Match the pace and level of review to the consequences of the decision. Write clearly, internally and externally. Produce policies, practical guidance, and public explanations of our safety approach. Help communicate our evaluations and findings, including their limitations. You’ll build initiatives or benchmarks we can share with the outside world to help us and the industry at large do better. Represent our thinking. Explain and defend our approach with partners, clinicians, and other audiences. Engage seriously with criticism and bring what you learn back into the work. About you You have strong judgment. You can reason through a difficult question, weigh competing considerations, and recommend a course of action without pretending every answer is certain. You’re an excellent writer and communicator. You can turn complex thinking into clear, precise prose. You enjoy doing the research and developing the argument as much as writing the final piece. You can present well and understand how to communicate what we’re doing to the outside world. You’ve built something and made it better. It could be a product, an operational process, a program, or an independent project. You can show how you moved from an unclear problem to something people used, then improved it through feedback. You’re resourceful and hands-on . You’re willing to investigate individual cases, coordinate people, write the checklist, and follow up until the work is done. You seek out expertise without needing someone else to supply every answer. You know when to consult a clinician, engineer, lawyer, or researcher, and can turn their input into a practical decision. You’re intellectually curious and willing to change your mind. You can explain a time when evidence challenged your assumptions and changed your approach. You handle sensitive information with care and stay thoughtful under pressure. You recognize that this role will involve handling difficult topics on a regular basis including abuse, eating disorders, suicide and death. You can handle these topics maturely and know how to manage your own mental health, seeking support for yourself as needed. You care deeply about people’s mental health and the opportunity in front of us. You want more people to have access to good support, and you take responsibility for the trust that requires. You might come from product, operations, consulting, law, policy, psychology, cognitive science, or another field that has taught you to think rigorously, write well, and execute. Clinical qualifications and previous trust and safety experience are useful, but neither is required. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Computational Chemistry
description: LOCATION: King’s Cross, London · PATTERN: Hybrid, flexible for the right candidate The opportunity We’re a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You’d help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role builds our computational chemistry from the start. You would own how a set of target molecules becomes a synthesis plan that automated equipment can run, and how every compound we work with is represented and registered. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team. The role You will own computational chemistry end to end, from the molecules someone wants made to the plan the lab executes. The role sits at the interface between synthetic chemistry, cheminformatics and software, and lab automation, and you will build the computational capability alongside the physical synthesis and automation capability from an early stage. The role is embedded with the synthetic chemists and the automation scientists and engineers, and you will work with them every day. Much of the value comes from drawing out what experienced chemists know and turning their judgement into rules, models and workflows that apply the same way every time. Two parts of the role go beyond standard computational chemistry, and they are why it matters so much. Routes that automation can execute. A chemically plausible route is only the starting point. Planning has to account for what the platform can do, including the building blocks and reagents available, the reaction classes and conditions it supports, handling constraints, work-up and purification, and throughput. It also has to work across a whole target set. Given hundreds or thousands of targets, you will find the shared chemistry, common intermediates and building blocks, and reduce them to a manageable set of synthetic strategies, balancing diversity and compound value against synthetic cost. You will work with the automation team to define what planning hands to the systems downstream, and over time connect planning, synthesis and experimental results so that each round of results improves the next plan. Chemical identity from the outset. The digital representation and identity of compounds has to be right from the start, because other scientific teams will rely on compound registration for chemical identity, as well as synthesis planning. You will establish when two structures represent the same chemical entity and when they do not, and handle stereoisomers, salts, tautomers, protonation and charge states and other representation and normalisation questions consistently. You will be the first person in this seat. You will choose the methods, set the standards, write the first production code and shape how the capability grows, including who joins it. Your first 90 days FIRST 30 DAYS ◆ Learn how the synthetic chemists and the automation team work, and what the synthesis platform will and will not support. ◆ Agree the rules for chemical identity with the chemists, covering structure normalisation, validation and deduplication, and how stereochemistry, isomers, salts, tautomers and charge states are handled. ◆ Start ingesting vendor catalogues and building-block inventories through supplier APIs and external chemical data sources, capturing availability, cost and metadata so they can act as planning constraints. ◆ Agree with the automation team what a synthesis plan has to specify for the platform to execute it. DAYS 30 TO 60 ◆ Set up compound-registration workflows and identifiers that downstream systems can rely on. ◆ Run a first planning pass on a real target set, generating, evaluating and ranking routes and grouping targets by shared chemistry, intermediates and building blocks. DAYS 60 TO 90 ◆ Build the platform’s capabilities and constraints into planning, so routes are scored on whether they can be executed as well as whether they are plausible. ◆ Add selection across the target set that weighs diversity and compound value against synthetic cost, step count and throughput. ◆ Connect compounds, reactions and experimental results to the wider digital chemistry stack (ELN, LIMS and compound registration), and set out how results will feed back into the route and reaction models. Who you are You work across disciplines. You might be a computational chemist or cheminformatician who has spent real time with synthetic chemists, or a synthetic chemist who moved into modelling and software and still cares whether a route works at the bench. You have built synthesis-planning or chemical-data tools that other people relied on, and you know where they break. You think in sets of molecules as well as single ones. You are comfortable making decisions on incomplete information, writing them down, and changing them when the data says so. You listen carefully to chemists, because much of what this role needs is in their judgement and has never been written down. This is a founding seat. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>Anaplan is seeking an <strong>ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE <span style="text-decoration: underline;">focused on Financial Services</span></strong>, to drive its growth and expand its presence in the London area. </p> <p>In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management to sell an incredibly versatile platform to the most strategic Banks and Insurance companies.</p> <p>Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales, this type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new strategic logos as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engaging with targeted prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,</li> <li>Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,</li> <li>Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,</li> <li>Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,</li> <li>Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,</li> <li>Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,</li> <li>Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience and network in Financial services: Banks, Insurance companies, Investment funds, etc.</li> <li>Extensive experience in consultative sales to deals (services and/or software),</li> <li>Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,</li> <li>Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner & internal team organizations,</li> <li>Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&A, Workforce Planning & Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,</li> <li>Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,</li> <li>Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills</strong></p> <ul> Applicants should only use our job board to submit an application, and will interact directly with our team during this process.</span></em></p> <hr> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is a <strong>Full-Time</strong> Role (40 hours per week, 5DWW) with no option for part-time work. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must be a resident of the Netherlands or in the U.K. at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam or London. <br></span></em><em>Please visit <a href="https://boards.greenhouse.io/blab" target="_blank">our Careers page</a> to review all opportunities and submit your application for the role(s) that best fit your location and work authorization. <strong>This job ad will close automatically at 9:00AM EST on October 23rd</strong>.</em></p> <hr> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The Data & AI team is responsible for building B Lab's data platform, delivering on business priorities, and bringing AI into how B Lab works. We approach AI deliberately, and with people and planet in view. B Lab is currently exploring how to use AI in a responsible way, aligned with our values and mission. The team reports directly to the CTDO. AI Enablement is one of three pillars within Data Analytics & AI, the demand side of the Data & AI team. It drives responsible, practical AI adoption across B Lab through three connected roles. The Senior Manager of Data Analytics & AI leads the branch and brings the knowledge of B Lab's systems and data infrastructure. The AI Workflow Lead works with teams to design and scale AI workflows. The AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead builds the learning paths and skills that help people use them well.</span></p> <h2><strong>About the Opportunity</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The <strong>AI Workflow Lead </strong> is B Lab's AI workflow builder: an internal “consultant” who works closely with teams on the ground to understand how they work, find where AI can add the most value, and turn those opportunities into scalable, responsible AI workflows. Aside from internal processes, as you grow an understanding of our products, you will be working closely with our Product team to help identify opportunities in which AI can add meaningful value.  </span><br><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The role takes an organisation-level view. It runs the discovery and design behind cross-team workflows, coordinates delivery with the Data & AI team, Data engineering and the teams involved, and helps build the champion networks that carry adoption forward. It keeps a continuous picture of how AI is being used across B Lab, and where it falls short. Those insights feed the training built by the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead, and the role measures whether the workflows and programmes we run actually deliver.</span><br><span style="font-size: 12pt;">It sits within Data & AI and reports to the Senior Manager of Data Analytics & AI. Together with the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead, it brings insights back to shape AI strategy collectively, which is then taken to the CTDO. It works across every function, with Product & Platform Engineering, and with governance and compliance stakeholders. The role works closely with the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead and will cover core AI-enablement responsibilities during that role's parental leave.</span></p> <h2><strong>Core Responsibilities </strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Workflow Discovery & Design (40%)</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Work closely with teams on the ground to understand their processes, pain points and goals, using interviews, process mapping and design thinking to find high-value AI opportunities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Design and ship  team and organisation-level AI workflows from idea to scaled solution, coordinating with the Data & AI team, Data engineering and the teams impacted.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Identify and scope meaningful AI opportunities in product-facing surfaces such as the B Impact platform, partnering with Product & Platform Engineering, and with the data/platform team where data or ML builds are needed.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Turn successful pilots into standard, supported workflows that other teams can adopt.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Use-Case Pipeline & Landscape Monitoring (20%)</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Run a structured use-case pipeline (intake → evaluate → pilot → scale), so AI adoption is systematic rather than ad hoc.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Continuously monitor how AI is being used across the organisation, including what works, where limitations appear, and where risks emerge, and feed these insights into the training built by the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Scan the AI landscape for new tools, capabilities and risks, and evaluate tools against clear criteria, including responsible-use, privacy and security considerations.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Impact Measurement (15%)</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Measure the impact of the AI workflows and programmes we run, including time saved, quality and ROI, and report clearly on what is working and what isn't. (People's skills progression is tracked by the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead.)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build simple dashboards and analyses that make adoption and impact visible to stakeholders.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Insight, Strategy & Adoption Support (15%)</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Together with the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead, report insights to the Senior Manager of Data Analytics & AI, so that AI strategy is shaped collectively and based on operational reality.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Recommend where to invest in tools and workflows; decisions are co-made with the Senior Manager of Data Analytics & AI and the CTDO.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Help develop and support AI champion networks across teams and regions, so that good practice spreads beyond individual projects.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Act as a point of contact for use-case and workflow questions from staff, escalating policy questions to the AI Enablement & Learning Platform Lead.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Support responsible use and governance in practice (policy, guardrails and approval workflows owned elsewhere).</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Other projects and team coverage (10%)</strong></span></p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>4–6 years of direct experience in data, product, operations, learning or change, with hands-on experience or demonstrated interest in AI.</strong></span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Science, Business, Computer Science, Social Sciences or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience leading or contributing to projects that changed how a team works, such as process improvement, tool adoption or digital transformation.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Using generative AI tools (e.g. LLM-based assistants, custom GPTs or agents) in real workflows, including prompt design, testing outputs and understanding their limitations.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Workflow automation and no-/low-code tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), and a working understanding of how APIs and integrations connect systems.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Process mapping and documentation (e.g. Miro, Lucidchart or similar) to capture current and future-state workflows.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Designing measurement approaches: setting baselines, defining success metrics, and running small tests or pilots to compare approaches.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Survey design and qualitative analysis (e.g. interview synthesis, thematic coding).</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><br></strong>Profile of someone who would thrive in this role:<strong><br></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Curiosity about AI and how work is changing. You understand how changes to a workflow, team or technology can affect data, time, quality, risk and other parts of an organisation, and you consider those connections when making decisions.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">An evidence-first mindset. title: Finance & Accounting Advisory - Senior Manager
description: Senior Manager - Accounting Advisory Senior Managers at CFGI will work closely with ‘C-level’ management of FTSE 100, mid-cap, and start-up companies. CFGI Senior Managers lead project teams and interact with clients and their Big 4 auditors on all aspects of engagements, including report writing, developing and managing client relationships, and business development. Take ownership of your career at CFGI: · Gain exposure to a wide range of industries and/or projects. · Make a true business impact with your clients. · Own projects from start to finish. · Experience client interaction and thrive in a client-facing role. · Be consistently challenged and learn through a collegial environment created from top tier experts hired within the firm. · Enjoy the flexibility of office/remote/client site work locations (engagement specific). · Create your own path. · Enjoy what you do! What you might expect: · Interact with clients’ executive team and auditors, serving as a subject matter expert, leading clients through complex accounting issues and driving conclusions. · Lead client engagement and own client delivery on operational due diligence for complex transactions (i.e. – IPO’s, acquisitions and divestitures, stock offerings, and debt raises). · Drive client deliverables of financial and regulatory information in accordance with regulatory requirements. · Serve as a subject expert matter on projects related to new accounting standards. · Lead process improvement projects and implementation of changes. · Mentor managers and consultants, acting as a moral and ethical role model, fostering engagement team professional growth, and providing constructive and actionable feedback. · Lead firm initiatives and identify areas for improvements. · Play an active role in the firm’s recruiting efforts, client relationship building, and business development efforts. Who you are: · An undergraduate degree in Accounting – ACA, ACCA, CPA and/or MBA combined with solid accounting experience will be considered in lieu of a degree in accounting. · Eight plus years of experience in public accounting and/or industry accounting and /or finance. · Outstanding interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with an ability to assimilate easily into teams. · Strong technical skills and a working knowledge of IFRS, UK GAAP and US GAAP. · Proactive in identifying client needs and effective in building a strong relationship with clients. · Highly organized and focused and demonstrates the ability to set overall engagement expectations and direction. · Effective analytical and critical thinking abilities. · Entrepreneurial nature, self-motivated, ethical, and dependable. · Commitment to quality client service, focusing on ensuring positive resolutions to conflicts. · Consistently seek opportunities to enhance your skills by attending higher-level training, developing firm training materials, and enhancing the overall firm knowledge base. title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
description: About Smartnumbers We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams.
